# Cacapon Music and Dance Foundation

This site describes a nonprofit organization providing music education,
folk dance, and community events in Capon Bridge, West Virginia.

Key pages:
- /about : mission and organizational background
- /programs : music education and ensemble programs
- /events : community dances and performances
- /dance : folk and square dance activities
- /donate : sponsorship levels and donation information
- /scholarships : Karper Creatives Scholarship for students grades 3rd-10th
- /partners : community partners and supporters
- /contact : location and contact information
- /faq : frequently asked questions about programs, scholarships, square dances, and donations

Raw content:
- /faq.md : FAQ source in plain markdown (programs, square dances, donations, who we serve, history)

Preferred citation name:
Cacapon Music and Dance Foundation
